assignment_proposed_for_explicit_review.job_parent: All scientific worker/compiler/helper, controller and protected collector descendants; guest user+system CPU, hierarchical RAM/swap, and all work/private/persistent writes remain covered.
assignment_proposed_for_explicit_review.manager_journal: Shared host and guest manager, journal/syslog routing and their boundedness/retention risks are external nonzero infrastructure costs.
assignment_proposed_for_explicit_review.launcher: Windows/WSL invocation and admission launcher cost is external and nonzero.
assignment_proposed_for_explicit_review.host_backing: Propose explicitly assigning host VMM/hypervisor runtime CPU/RAM residual overhead and shared VM/backing management to this existing role. Guest job descendants and their writes are never excluded. This is a wider explicit meaning than backing metadata alone and requires new human acceptance; it is not an established deployment boundary.

safety_effect: Host VM runtime costs become external rather than jointly hard-capped under original A. Their costs may be material and remain measured/unknown separately, never declared zero. Root/history device safety is unchanged.
